plan.gap: Missing: source-supported step-by-step field sampling protocol for pre-harvest alfalfa yield estimation (e.g., PEAQ or scaled hand-cut quadrat method). Existing evidence covers post-harvest quality, cumulative dry-matter rate, and growth-stage indices — not the direct in-field measurement procedure with named inputs, units, and deterministic conversion to t/ha.
queries: PEAQ alfalfa pre-harvest yield estimation university extension protocol
alfalfa field sampling quadrat method yield prediction before cut

requirements.need: One directly relevant university extension or peer-reviewed source that names a specific field-sampling protocol (e.g., PEAQ, scaled hand-cut quadrat) for estimating alfalfa yield prior to harvest, with explicitly stated measured inputs (plant height, stem density, pod load, or cut-area weight) and output units (t DM/ha or similar).

A step-by-step sampling procedure with deterministic conversion from measured field inputs to estimated yield — no fabricated formula, no site-specific dimensions, no example yield numbers. Must name each input variable and its unit.

Source must be primary agricultural research or public extension (university-affiliated). Evidence scoped to pre-harvest field measurement only; post-harvest quality data, cumulative DM-rate papers, and growth-index indices do not satisfy this requirement.
